# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 - initial release

- Logo: official Google Slides product icon on a padded white tile.
- Added the `google-slides` MCP server pointing at `https://api.cursor.com/rest-mcp/google-slides/mcp`.
- Bundled the `google-slides` skill covering deck layout, styling, and per-slide PNG verification.
